checks.rule: OS Terrain 5 is a mid-resolution digital terrain model of Great Britain.
OS Terrain 5 grid data use 5 m post spacing.
OS Terrain 5 contour data use 5 m contour intervals.
The product is produced from photogrammetry.
OS Terrain 5 is intended for uses including environmental monitoring and regional risk assessment.
The product is updated every three months.
OS describes typical accuracy as greater than 2 m RMSE.
Do not use OS Terrain 5 as a precision substitute for Environment Agency 1 m LIDAR when the latter is available.
Do not interpret 5 m post spacing as vertical accuracy.
Mark OS Terrain 5 derived parcel height differences as fallback-grade rather than official high-precision measurements.
Require interpolation method to be recorded when parcel sample points do not coincide with Terrain 5 posts.
Keep Terrain 5 fallback uncertainty materially larger than ±15 cm LIDAR RMSE in confidence scoring.
